en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small coastal village seen from across a calm inlet. Wooden houses cluster densely along the rocky shoreline; several boats, including a small sailboat, are moored or moving on the water. Low rocky islands are visible in the foreground and background under a partly cloudy sky. The word "Stocken." is printed at the lower left, and a round photographer's or publisher's stamp appears at the lower right.
